strength.excerpt: The sulfur dioxide system used an aggregate cap and tradable allowances... Nitrogen oxides regulation... was rate-based, with no cap or allowance trading.
strength.reason: The central distinction is clear and supported with concrete program details.

weakness.excerpt: The program addressed both pollutants, but through distinct mechanisms and timelines.
weakness.reason: This restates the opening distinction rather than adding a takeaway or inviting meaningful engagement.
